headline: Tomb Raider - where Lara Croft began
title: Tomb Raider 1996 | How Lara Croft Was Born | Classic Games
video_script: Tomb Raider arrived in nineteen ninety six, developed by Core Design and published by Eidos Interactive. It starred archaeologist Lara Croft, created by artist Toby Gard, and sent her through ancient tombs in full polygonal three D, which was a big leap at the time. It first launched on the Sega Saturn, then reached PlayStation and PC. Lara became one of gaming's most recognisable icons. Did you play the original Tomb Raider? Comment below!
description: Tomb Raider launched in 1996, developed by Core Design and published by Eidos Interactive, introducing Lara Croft, created by Toby Gard, in full 3D adventures.
